settings.title: Settings
settings.generalSub: How OpenWorker looks and behaves on this machine.
settings.modelsSub: Providers and the models offered in the composer's picker. Keys are stored only on this computer.
settings.voiceInputSub: Speak naturally in the composer. Recordings and transcripts stay on this device.
settings.voiceInputDesktopOnly: Voice Input setup is available in the OpenWorker desktop app.
settings.privateByDesignFull: Audio is held in memory only while you record and is transcribed locally.
settings.micReady: Your microphone and local transcription engine are working.
settings.micSetup: Record a short phrase to enable the composer microphone.
settings.listeningSpeak: ● Listening… speak a short phrase, then stop.
settings.deleteWhisperConfirm: Delete the local voice model and disable Voice Input?
settings.noSpeechDetected: No speech was detected. Try again and speak for a little longer.
settings.voiceErrorFallback: Voice Input could not complete that action.
settings.personasSub: Which coworkers are enabled and shown in the picker, plus installing new persona bundles.
settings.browsePersonaGallerySub: Curated coworkers from the OpenWorker team — see what each can do before installing.
settings.textSizeHelp: Changes text only — the layout stays put. Remembered per device, and it applies to the phone view too.
settings.turn_style_desc: How each running step is shown. Timeline (default): always expanded, every step reviewable at any time. Cards: auto-expands while running so the thinking is live, then folds into a single 'N steps' line and shows the reply when done. Bubble: one-line status, tap to see all steps. Independent of Skin — does not change Xiaoju's look.
settings.sidebarHelp: Longer lists collapse behind “Show more”. Applies per coworker and per project.
settings.hide_reasoning_desc: While a task runs, collapse the fast-scrolling thinking text into a quiet “Thinking…” line. The full thinking still appears after the task ends.
settings.filesHelp: Each conversation gets its own folder under this location. Existing conversations keep their current folder; you can grant access to more folders inside any conversation.
settings.savedNewConversations: Saved. New conversations will use this location.
settings.trustedWorkspacesHelp: Trusted projects may manage their command allowances in .coworker/config.toml.
settings.noProjectCommandAllowances: No project command allowances currently declared
settings.openAtLoginDesc: Launch OpenWorker automatically when you sign in.
settings.keepAwakeDesc: Prevent idle sleep so scheduled tasks fire on time.
settings.safetyHelp: How OpenWorker guards the agent's shell. The execution level applies immediately; sandbox changes apply to new sessions.
settings.executionLevelHelp: Off: no command scanning. Auto (recommended): catastrophic commands are blocked, high-risk ones ask first. Strict: any flagged command asks first.
settings.sandboxEnabled: Run the shell inside a macOS sandbox
settings.sandboxEnabledHelp: Confines file writes to the workspace and blocks access to secrets (SSH keys, credentials, Keychain). Falls back to unsandboxed if unavailable.
settings.sandboxNetwork: Allow the sandboxed shell to reach the network
settings.sandboxNetworkHelp: Outbound connections only; inbound listen is always blocked (reverse-shell backstop). Turn off for maximum isolation.
settings.sandboxAppliesNew: Sandbox settings apply to new sessions — restart or start a new conversation to pick them up.
settings.setupHelp: Replays the first-run setup: model, first automation, tips.
settings.couldNotCheck: Couldn't check right now — try again later.
settings.downloadingRestart: Downloading — OpenWorker restarts by itself when it's ready.
settings.tokenSavingsHelp: PDF attachments travel with every turn of a conversation, so large documents multiply what you spend on tokens.
settings.pdfsNoNativePdf: PDFs on models without native PDF support
settings.pdfFallbackHelp: Claude, GPT and Gemini read PDFs natively — this only applies to models that don't (GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, local models…). Text extraction is cheapest; page images cost more tokens and need a vision-capable model.
settings.pdfLimitsHelp: PDFs over these limits are not attached — you'll see a notice in the composer instead.
settings.voiceInputErrorDefault: Voice Input could not complete that action.
